label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
The Winter School on Elliptic Curves and Modular Forms got over on Saturday, and on behalf of the organising team (Ketaki Joglekar, Faizan Mirza and myself) I want to thank everyone who made it possible.

We ran it from 5 to 7 November in Seminar Hall 2 of the Department of Mathematics, Sahyadri Institute of Science, Pune. We received 112 applications and selected 41 participants, MSc and early PhD students from 9 states, based on a statement and one reference. The institute's student initiative grant of Rs 2.4 lakh covered hostel stay and travel for 18 outstation students.

Thank you first to our speakers, who gave their time to a student-run school. Dr. Nilesh Dharmadhikari came from Hyderabad to lecture on the Mordell-Weil theorem, Dr. Sunanda Iyer came from Chennai to lecture on modular forms, and Dr. Tomasz Wierzbicki joined online from Kraków to teach computations in Sage.

Thank you to Prof. Anuradha Venkatesan, our faculty mentor, for guiding us throughout. To Mr. Prakash Salunke from the department office, who sorted out hostel rooms at 11 pm when our booking got messed up. And to the six PhD students who volunteered as TAs and ran the problem sessions. That format worked well and we would like to keep it.

Two things I will remember. On the second afternoon the power went for nearly two hours and the laptops died, so we shifted the problem session to the canteen with two rolling whiteboards. It turned out to be the best session of the three days. And an MSc student from Silchar found an error in a worked example in Dr. Iyer's notes. She corrected it live and thanked him.

Both of these are why I think small schools like this matter more than big conferences for MSc students. In a room of 41, people actually get to ask questions.

To all 41 participants, thank you for coming and for all the questions. Slides and problem sheets will be up on the department website within two weeks.

We hope to run a second edition in late 2027. That depends on the grant coming through, so I cannot promise yet, but the three of us are keen and we will post an update here once we know.
